goal: Implement the native chat timeline, local text composer, quote context, and message action foundation backed by Room persistence.
non_goals: Do not implement real LLM generation or provider calls.
Do not implement streaming, background generation jobs, notifications, or stale-result handling; those belong to NATIVE-P2-005 and Phase 3.
Do not implement real image file picker, parser, or multimodal model analysis; source/image import belongs to Phase 5.
Do not implement full notes/memory side effects beyond a visible deferred action where needed; memory mutations belong to NATIVE-P5-002.
Do not implement full citation/source evidence rendering; source evidence integration belongs to Phase 5.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Chat screen opens for the selected session and shows the selected session title.
Messages for the selected session persist through Room-backed repository behavior and render in chronological order after reload/restart.
User can enter text in a native composer and send a local user message.
Blank composer sends are rejected without creating a message.
Composer remains represented with an IME-safe bottom area using native Compose insets.
Quote reply can be selected from an existing message and creates visible/stored quote context for the next sent message.
Message quote context is persisted in the existing message quote table or equivalent schema v1 path.
Message action foundation exposes quote, note/deferred, regenerate/deferred, archive/delete where applicable without calling real LLM or memory side effects.
Image draft preview/cancel is represented as local draft UI state only, without file picker/parser implementation.
Automated tests cover message ordering/persistence, blank send rejection, quote persistence, and chat UI state/action modeling.
Legacy coverage registry is updated conservatively for LEG-012, LEG-013, LEG-014, LEG-015, LEG-018, and LEG-041.
verification_expectations: Follow TDD: add failing tests before production implementation for message repository behavior and chat UI state/action modeling.
Run focused core data, feature chat, and app JVM tests.
Run connected core data instrumentation if an ADB device is available.
Run native project test, lint, and app assembleDebug.
Install preview debug APK on the connected device and capture chat composer/quote/action/IME smoke evidence when feasible.
Use app pid/package-specific logcat filtering to avoid global AndroidRuntime false positives.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json and rebuild codegraph.
notes: Existing PRD/ARCH/TODO and prior user approval are the design basis for this task.
Use existing Room schema v1 tables for messages, attachments, and message_quotes where possible; avoid schema changes unless tests prove they are necessary.
Local user-message send is a native UI/data foundation only; assistant generation belongs to later LLM/runtime tasks.
